profile.name: Rehet Kalsi
profile.player_statement:
A complete player, Rehet Kalsi has made a big mark in cricket. With 83 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 70*, with an average of 14.71 and a quick strike rate of 64.01. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 16 sixes and 88 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 116.4 overs, taking 43 wickets at an economy rate of 5.36. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
